events.event: itch.io announced removal of adult NSFW material from discovery indexing during payment-provider scrutiny.
itch.io announced reindexing of adult NSFW content with No Payments selected, with paid content reintroduced more cautiously.

governance_layers.effect: A published page may become deindexed while still accessible by URL.
Permitted merchant activity depends on payment-provider acceptable-use and selected payout model.
The operator documents content classification requirements, restrictions and potential suspension or disabled payouts.
Paid access removal can trigger enforcement, refunds and payout issues.

limitations: A historical adult-content announcement is not evidence that all games were deindexed.
July 2025 announcements do not establish the exact paid adult-content indexing situation on October 26, 2026.
No number of affected commercial sellers, lost sales or present-day account suspensions is reported by these sources.
Keep policy adherence and downstream payment eligibility distinct from sales probability.
